verdict.rationale: Runway documents its own editing of existing footage: Aleph 2.0 is described as 'precise video editing', the platform offers an 'AI video editor' for real footage, and the API exposes video-to-video. A hands-on user also reported near-seamless masks that tracked changing poses, which supports isolating an element. However, no evidence explicitly shows replacing or restyling a specific element while the rest of the frame is preserved, and other commenters called the masking demos cherry-picked. Missing for 10: explicit docs on element-level replace/restyle with frame preservation, controls for selecting the target element, independent hands-on evidence of element replacement quality.
